result.title: HCFM: Helmholtz Component Flow Matching for Time Series Anomaly Detection
result.comment: To appear as a conference paper in ICDE 2027
result.summary: Flow Matching (FM) is an efficient simulation-free approach for training flow-based generative models, making it a promising foundation for scalable time-series anomaly detection (TSAD). However, standard FM learns a monolithic vector field in which nominal transport and local density-changing behavior are entangled. This creates a central challenge for TSAD; local expansion and contraction carry crucial anomaly-sensitive information, yet isolating this signal requires expensive Jacobian-trace estimation over the entire field. We propose \emph{Helmholtz Component Flow Matching} (HCFM), an unsupervised TSAD framework that parameterizes the vector field prediction network with separate transport, compression, and residual heads. The transport head is constrained to be divergence-free, so divergence estimation is restricted to the compression head, while a lightweight residual head absorbs the remaining mismatch. This structured parameterization improves scalability and detection performance by separating volume-preserving nominal transport from density-changing compression, yielding cleaner anomaly signals from distinct deviations of nominal behavior. Experiments on large-scale univariate and multivariate TSAD benchmarks show that HCFM consistently improves detection accuracy while maintaining efficient inference compared with 16 baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/TrustAIoT/HCFM__time-series-anomaly/

AI.brief_summary: 提出 HCFM，一种无监督时间序列异常检测框架，用 Helmholtz 式分解把 Flow Matching 的向量场拆成无散度的传输头、压缩头与残差头，把散度估计限制在压缩头上，从而以更低成本分离保体积的常态传输与改变密度的压缩信号。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把状态演化的「保体积传输」与「密度改变」结构化分离、并用轻量残差头吸收不匹配的做法，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态更新的贡献分配与信息坍缩诊断提供可核查的分解线索，但与多模态推理主线无直接关联。
